messages.text: Can you swing by Rose's after work? The counter strips and the little blue box are ready at Walgreens.
Yeah, I get off at 2. I'll grab those and bring the tomatoes she wanted too.
Thank you. Rick said he can sit with her Friday, but today I am stuck at the front counter until close.
Tell Dad I saw his voicemail. I'll call him after I drop everything off.
PG&E email came in. Your half is $46. I put the paper by the microwave.
Sending it after my shift. Can you leave the porch light on if I get back after 10?
Already set. Also your towel is still in the dryer, please grab it before morning.
Got it. I told Kayla no Friday thing here, I need the place quiet after this week.
I opened the bank thing six times since dinner and now I can't tell if the rent math is real or just me doing loops.
The rent portal still has your old Oakdale Rd mailing address saved. Want me to switch it to our place?
Put the phone on the table. Write rent, PG&E, and groceries on paper. Three numbers only.
Yeah, thanks. Funny that every address I typed for that program form is still within like 12 minutes of here.
Doing that. Also wiped the stove while waiting for the page to load again, so at least the kitchen looks less tragic.
I left the heating pad on your chair and moved the laundry basket so you don't have to bend around it tonight.
If the Pasadena hotel thing actually answers, we should talk through what happens with your room before April bills.
Thank you. The brunch-to-close stretch was a lot. I'm skipping the Target jeans for now and putting today's cash toward that black non-slip pair.
Only if it is real money or a serious kitchen/front desk track. I am not boxing up all my stuff for a maybe.
Good. Rent clears Friday, so keep the receipt and don't talk yourself into the cute stuff aisle.
Good. I'll look at the paper with you when I get home, not the app.
Deal. Also can you leave the little orange bottle on the kitchen counter? I'm going straight to shower when I get in.
If booth 4 asks again, was it rye toast or sourdough with the veggie scramble?
Rye, no butter. And he wants salsa on the side, not on the plate.
Good catch. Table 2 also asked me how to say extra napkins and I froze.
Mas servilletas, por favor. I used it with them yesterday and they smiled.
Did you ever compare those Measure B writeups? Customers kept arguing about it at the counter today.
I have the county booklet open and two tabs from those local groups. Still circling names in pencil on the kitchen table.
Look at who funded the glossy mailers too. Those smaller races get weird fast.
Yeah, that is where I get lost. The big November sheet is easy; the tiny ones I have skipped before when work got too much.
I was supposed to sleep after one more video. Then the Bridge posted rehearsal pics and I got stuck.
You still doing that downtown thing Saturday or did they finally realize folding chairs fear you
I am on chair duty AND front table, thank you. I will greet strangers with the power of a tired auntie at a yard sale.
Please don't scare the kids before the face paint booth opens
Kids get stickers. Parents get directions. The crew hauling the heavy stuff gets first dibs on the good donuts.
Did you see the girl doing the diner-tray footwork thing? Sent it to you.
Yes and now my saved folder is a mess: that, the garlic noodle thing, and the mural painter from downtown.
You are up organizing clips like it's homework.
I found the old box from the Pelton Ave house. Your dad's route maps, my Save Mart name tags, and some school envelopes are all mixed together.
Don't toss those. Tyler will laugh at the one with his tiny basketball shoes in it.
I also found Grandma Rose's spare key from when she was two streets over. That drawer is a time capsule.
I'll come by after my shift and help sort it before dinner.
Did you see the school board mailer? One of them says they want to freeze the after-school music money again.
I put it on the fridge. I'm checking who actually voted on bus routes and clinic hours before I fill anything in.
Good. Grandma always says look at what they did, not the shiny paper.
Exactly. If someone is decent on rent and schools but bad on small shops, I want to know that too.
County page says the mobile clinic is by the library Friday till 6. I can cover the first ten if you go before dinner rush.
That helps. My arm can be annoying on a tray shift, so I wanted a nurse to tell me which day makes sense.
Yeah do not let Facebook Aunties schedule your body. Ask the person with the badge.
Exactly. Too many tables and then Grandma Rose Sunday. I want the boring official answer.
You still heading to the 6:30 opening on J Street after your shift?
Yeah, if I can change fast. Marisol said she can save me a spot near the back.
Good. No cover tonight, so I am not listening to you talk yourself out of it over tips.
Fair. I already saw Kayla at brunch, then you later, so I am basically doing the full Modesto lap today.
City Hall posted the agenda for Thursday. Same board seats, complaint data, and body cam storage item.
I saved it. Reminds me of that summer 2020 night by the courthouse when everyone kept asking for records instead of speeches.
Yeah. If you go, ask about the form people use after stops. Most folks don't even know where it lives.
I only learned because of my old brake-light warning and then that one 2 a.m. neighbor call.
You still trying to get in on those Tuesday night runs at MRC or did work steal your legs
I put my name down after lunch. If they call me back I need you to stop making me look bad on the left side.
Left side? You mean the whole court lol. I get off at 5:30 Friday if you want to warm up there.
Friday works. I will bring water if you bring whatever trash video you were laughing at yesterday.
That empty spot by 10th still has the ugly tile. You taking measurements for your imaginary espresso empire or what
You still going to the river trail before that open-mic thing Friday?
Do not disrespect the tile, it has character. Also the left wall is exactly long enough for six frames if the counter stays short.
Yeah, I want ten quiet minutes by the water first. Then I can show up loose instead of stiff.
Six frames and tiny tables. Where do the people yelling made-up scenes go
Bring the ankle wrap if you're doing your whole kitchen-floor routine again.
Already packed. The guitar loop in that set makes the turn section feel right.
Back corner after 7. No one yells before close, I have standards.
Are you going downtown after work or coming home first?
Straight there. I threw the black shoes and wrap in my tote this morning.
Good. Last year's foothills mistake does not need a sequel.
I'm keeping it light tonight. If the left side complains, I'm marking instead of trying to look cute.
You still coming for coffee after the lunch rush?
Only if we keep it tiny. My March sheet is already pushing toward 1800 because of the car place.
Gas station coffee then. I have a coupon thing.
Perfect. I am trying not to touch the separate 400 I left alone.
Rosa had you on the break chart today? I saw your little boxes by booth 9 lol
She made me redo it twice because I forgot Mateo's lunch before the kitchen rush.
You survived the window side today? I saw table 6 keep waving the cup around.
Still, she let you touch the order clipboard. That only started after her Monday talk with you.
Barely. I clocked out with syrup on my sleeve and my bun held together by two pins.
Yeah. I keep hearing her say I can be more than the person making everyone laugh at sidework.
Same. You’re on the 6:00 one again Monday, right? I’ll leave the clean aprons up front.
Yeah, Monday makes three this week already. Please hide one apron before the brunch pile eats them.
Mateo wants Lucky's after close. You coming or heading home?
I'll come for one cider and fries, then I'm out. Early double tomorrow.
Inside booth this time? Last patio was gross.
Please. My jacket smelled like the patio buckets for two days. And the little green tin stays home until I'm done with both shifts.
If you go by the downtown stalls, check if the pepper lady is there. Mine got sad in the fridge.
I can swing by after laundry if the line is not ridiculous. Need tomatoes too.
Grab the ugly ones if they discount them. They cook down fine.
Exactly. Peppers get stuffed, tomatoes go in rice, and I am leaving the tip envelope alone.
That city packet you sent is 68 pages. You really read the sidewalk seating chart?
Only the downtown map and fee table. I wrote the numbers beside the little front-window sketch.
Send me the links again. The pop-up night photos had better lighting than the city examples.
I saved them in one folder with the mural names and the cheap folding-table setup.
You home? Mom asked if you want tacos or if you're stopping near McHenry first.
I'm grabbing eggs by our place. Parking lot is packed again from all the late-shift cars.
Lol that strip by you always has somebody outside. Tell Marisol I still have her Tupperware.
She'll remember. I'm putting groceries in my room first so the front stays clean.
You still coming to shoot around Sunday or did the diner steal you again?
They posted through next Friday and I only got one good room block. I told Linda I can cover Sunday breakfast if nobody grabs it.
You still awake or did that practice packet win?
Sunday breakfast sounds brutal but that usually means people actually leave cash.
Awake. Fractions are being rude. The first page asked last grade finished and I just stared at it for a minute.
Exactly. Car payment plan is staring at me, so basketball might be burgers after instead.
Put the number down and keep moving. You have diner math every day, just with pancakes yelling at you.
I put 8 and kept going. Saving the next $40 from tips instead of throwing it at that card tonight.
Mom, on this clinic tablet there are two back-to-back family background pages. Do I copy what you and Dad usually put?
Yes, same as us. First page is the plain box we always use, and the next page never applied to our side.
Got it. It also wants city and state from my old record, so I am putting Modesto, CA and 09/14/1999 exactly.
Use the county copy if they question it. I still have mine and your dad's papers in the hall folder too.
My front desk had a 9:40 chair open tomorrow, but they want payment at booking unless the paperwork is already cleared.
I can’t risk putting $95 down before rent. Also Kayla already asked me to cover the breakfast rush.
Then don’t squeeze it. I’ll watch for another cancellation after your county packet updates.
Thank you. My mouth has been fine, I just hate how long I’ve let the routine stuff slide.
That farmers market page posted the citrus vendor again. You still trying that salsa idea?
Yeah, saved the vendor post on FB so I don't lose it. The quick version I saved last night used oranges and jalapeno.
Send it after shift. Also the little gallery on J has new paintings up.
Already saw it on my feed this morning. Their stories are better than the flyer.
Mom asked if your thick county packet is still on the microwave lol
It is in my bag now. I need you to remind me tomorrow after burgers to drop the sealed envelope.
Got you. You doing every page or just the big names?
Trying every page this time. Last little spring thing came and went before I even opened it.
You already out the door? I made extra coffee if you want to swing by after.
Already pinned my hair up and heading to Sunrise. I’m off around 2:30 if nothing runs long.
Eat something before the morning crowd gets there. You get short with people when you skip breakfast.
Granola bar in my bag. This is shift 4 since Monday, so coffee after sounds perfect.
Can you check the CDC chart for Grandma Rose before we pick a pharmacy day? I cannot tell what that post your cousin sent is even saying.
I'll look after breakfast shift. I trust the chart more than a screenshot with ten exclamation points.
Thank you. She has the foot appointment next week, so I want the simple version before I drive her anywhere.
I'll call the clinic desk too. The nurse there explained it plain last time.
For Sunday pasta, should I make enough for you and whoever you might bring?
Just me. I may stop by for one plate and head out early before laundry piles up.
Okay. Is Marisol coming too or working at the dental office?
She closes that day. We are doing groceries Saturday so the fridge is not sad.
When you pick up Grandma's bag at Roseburg Pharmacy, do you need anything added for you?
Just hers. My clinic form was quick: no bottles to list, no pharmacy line.
Good. Eat before you come by; I made pasta.
I'll stop after work, eat, then head home. Tonight is lights-off-by-10, tiny corner from the tin if my head keeps looping.
Mrs. Alvarez said you made her grandson laugh at the table by the raffle baskets
He asked where the treasure map was, so obviously I had to point him toward the bathroom line like it was a dragon cave.
You always make a place feel less stiff. Just don't stay late cleaning after everybody leaves.
I only stayed until the last cart was loaded. The guys lifting tables looked worn out, so I wasn't leaving them with mystery boxes.
Did the mechanic take the last payment today?
Yeah. The little side account shows 612 now, so I am leaving it alone.
Good. Eat at home tonight, baby.
I am. The Visa app is still sitting around 1200, so pasta wins.
Can you cover my last side work tonight or are you doing that MRC thing after close?
I can cover napkins but I need out by 7. Tyler said he is meeting me there and the front desk closes early.
Fine, napkins only. Do not come in tomorrow limping and blaming the diner floor.
If you take section 4 tonight, wear the newer pair. That tile by the soda station is unforgiving.
I'm bringing them if the heel isn't rubbing. I put the green dress back at Ross yesterday so the shoe money survives.
Adult choice, annoying but valid. I have extra bandages in my locker if they need breaking in.
Perfect. I also threw the travel pack from the medicine drawer into my bag just in case.
You left your black pen by the register. Same one from the page with lavender syrup and tamarind soda?
Yes, don't let it disappear. That page also has the open-mic receipt math on the back.
I found the clip you asked about. Woman in Stockton did a poetry night with five prints on the brick wall.
Send it after close? I want to compare her setup with the permit note I copied yesterday.
I put the rent split in the notebook. Your green envelope says 620 now, right?
Yeah. I want it at 2,000 before my car tries me again. Also asking Kayla if I can trade the random closings for the same three nights.
Good. Same nights means you can actually make those classes instead of begging the schedule app.
That is the plan. Envelope, card balance down, then Tuesday and Thursday evenings stay mine.
Rent cleared. Please do not buy another ticket before Friday unless it is one of the donation-jar ones.
I know. Tonight is just the 7:00 salsa thing at El Patio, $5 at the door if we get there before the lesson.
Fine. I will meet you there after my appointment. Mateo said he may stop by too.
Perfect. I am seeing Kayla for coffee first, then coming straight over.
Your diner notebook is on the kitchen table. I didn't move it because it has all those table numbers and bread counts.
Thank you. I need it before 6. Rosa wants me to compare last Thursday's prep list with tomorrow's order.
Since when are you willingly doing homework after a closing shift?
Since she said the fall lineup might change and that my list-making actually shows up when it matters.
Gallery walk downtown starts at 6. You and Marisol coming after your side of town clears out?
Maybe. Kids are still riding through the lot and Mrs. Ramos is waiting for her ride, so I'm not moving my car yet.
Fair. That McHenry stretch gets busy right when everyone changes shifts.
If we go, Marisol wants to stop for cheap noodles first. We already did the $725 each thing this week.
Kayla said you were staring at the schedule board like it owed you money.
Because Friday got switched and my phone keeps telling me my balance is lower than my brain promised.
Do the notebook math before you keep refreshing. Also you still coming to dance after close?
Yeah. If I write the shift times and cash-out number first, I can probably make it to the floor instead of pacing by the lockers.
Grandma asked if you wanted a ride Sunday morning to St. Mary's. No pressure, just checking.
Tell her I love her, but I'm working brunch. I might stop by after and sit with her for a bit.
She'll like that. She still has that little candle for you on the kitchen shelf.
I know. I use the one she gave me when I need a quiet minute before practice.
Kayla said you picked up her Saturday close. You trying to live at Sunrise now?
Only until the 18th. My Tuesday lunch was dead and the card slips were sad.
Saturday close should fix some of that if the theater crowd shows up.
Please. I need that plus Friday dinner to look less embarrassing on the rent spreadsheet.
Did Sunrise ever answer your question about the packet for full-timers?
That clip about the clinic closing is flying around again. You buying it?
That story about your mom doing a front counter shift then making dinner for everyone sounded exhausting.
Only that we get a few sick hours and the rest is basically “figure it out.” No one to ask except the manager.
Not yet. County agenda says they only moved Saturday hours, so I'm not reposting drama.
That was normal at our place. Dad would come in with cardboard dust on his boots and Tyler would still ask for a ride to the rec center.
Fair. The same meeting has the street-vendor fee thing too.
That tracks. Keep screenshots of your schedule if you’re calling that county line again.
Yeah, I marked that. People need care open on weekends and tiny vendors shouldn't get buried in forms.
Already did. I need proof I can’t take the first weekday slot they toss me.
And Grandma was close enough to send you over for tortillas, right?
Yep. Half my teenage errands were between our house, her kitchen, and whatever store Mom was at.
I found your high school shot records and the lease copy from the Coffee Rd apartment in the drawer.
Perfect. The form wants proof for the last few places, and mine are basically Coffee, Oakdale, then here.
Are you still looking at that short art residency north of here, or was that just one of your late-night tabs?
Still looking. If it is only summer and they help with supplies, I could make it work without giving up my room.
That family from the window table came back. Kid still can't have cheese right?
Right, and mom likes the hash browns extra crisp. Dad gets hot sauce but not the smoky one.
Also they asked me something with 'sin' and I guessed wrong.
If they say sin queso, leave off cheese. I can take them if they sit in your section.
The flyers from the MJC photo kids are still by the break room sink. You want them before Kayla tosses everything?
Yes please. I told them I would keep notes on size, prices, and who has never hung anything in public before.
You are making a whole spreadsheet for wall space again, aren't you
Only one tab. Maybe two if I add Friday night scene games.
Grandma found that envelope with your hospital bracelet-looking thing. It says 9/14/99 and the Modesto stamp is huge.
Please do not roast my tiny wrist era. Can you send a pic before Mom files it away again?
Sent. Also there are matching Chapman copies for Mom and Dad in the same folder, all from here, which feels very on brand for us.
That saves me a trip if the clerk copy takes too long.
Rec center later? They had open court last Saturday.
Maybe after errands. My legs are toast from Thursday but I want shots up before summer runs start.
No hero moves then. You still do that tiny-step thing since the trail day?
Only when I forget to warm up. Bring the cheap burgers plan and I'll bring tape.
Grandma asked if you still have that picture of us at Dad's barbecue. She wants it printed small.
I do. I'll print it before I take her list to FoodMaxx tomorrow.
Want me to carry stuff up? I can come after warehouse if Mom is not already there.
That would help. Rose's porch step was annoying last time with both bags.
Mom says your supervisor paperwork has that background page. Need me to scan anything at work?
No scan needed. The courthouse section is blank for me, so it was mostly addresses and references.
Easy then. Except you always write essays in tiny boxes.
Only on the part about handling customer complaints fairly. After the 2020 courthouse night I can't write one sentence on that.
Can you cover my 6-10 Friday if I take your Sunday brunch?
Friday is okay. I already handled my county envelope last week, so Sunday brunch trade works.
Responsible Sandi. Did Mateo send you that plain-English sheet for the judge stuff?
He did. I compared it with the county booklet before I sealed anything.
I found that old folder in Grandma's hall closet. It only has report cards through spring before you stopped going over there.
That is probably enough for the lady at Reno Ave. I was fifteen and thought I was just fixing one problem.
Bring it anyway. One folder does not decide the rest of your life.
I know. I just want the paper part finished so I can start the kitchen nights in April.
Can you send me the dance combo from class? I only caught half of it.
Sent the short one in DMs. It's the same creator I keep saving, with the blue kitchen in the background.
Also the county fair page is posting volunteer stuff on FB again. Worth checking?
Maybe. I saw it after Auntie tagged Mom, then got distracted by Sunrise accounts posting brunch specials.
Gallery doors are 7:30. Do you want me to meet you there or at the oak path first?
Oak path first, please. I need the outside part before the loud room.
Got it. I packed the small speaker, but only if you actually stretch and don't launch into spins cold.
Fair. That bassline is the only thing making the ending land.
I paid MID and internet. Your part comes to $86.40 when you can send it.
Sending after tips hit. Thanks for doing the math.
No problem. Same as usual, I kept PG&E on my card so we can even it out with groceries.
Works. Also the hallway washer is free if you need it before Mrs. Kline starts her loads.
You still going to the health office thing before Sunday brunch or did Kayla scare you with her sore-arm speech
Going. I read the county FAQ and the CDC page, then asked Tasha's clinic friend. Same answer all three places.
Respect. Tomorrow we have the bus-tour regulars plus the church table, so hydrate and don't take the heavy patio section.
I swapped with Kayla already. I just want it done before the older crowd weekend starts.
Your form go through? The guy at the desk said summer spots fill fast.
Yeah, he stamped it. I picked Tuesdays because my diner schedule is less awful then.
Good. We should get shots up this weekend so you do not embarrass the family name.
Say that again after I beat you from the corner.
Morning, mija. Did you sleep or did you keep checking numbers?
A little of both. I checked before bed, then again at 2, then made a list for today so I wouldn't forget Grandma's pharmacy run.
Call me after your shift if the day starts stacking up. One thing at a time.
I will. I'm putting the errands in order now and leaving the bank app alone until lunch.
Do you know yet if you can come for pasta Wednesday, or should I plan Thursday?
Ask me after Linda posts the next paper. Last week I knew by Tuesday morning, but sometimes she changes it before lunch.
Okay. Don't wear yourself out chasing every open spot.
Before your lunch shift, did you get the pair you talked about or are you still using the thin ones?
I won't. I just need two stronger nights before April rent, not a whole marathon.
Got them on sale. They look plain, but I made myself pass the clearance racks because PG&E is due.
Plain is fine if you can get through the day. Put something in your bag before you leave, same as Grandma does before errands.
Already packed water, crackers, and the small bottle. I'll call after close if I'm not asleep.
Any chance you can take my 10-2 Tuesday? Rose got moved to that morning slot and Mom can't leave work.
I can, but you owe me the easy booths next Sunday.
Done. I need to get her there, stop at CVS after, then take the bags inside before I head back.
Put it in the swap app before Mateo steals my coffee break again.
They asked if you can do the gate for the April street night too. I said ask Sandi, she has opinions about clipboards.
A clipboard is a tiny throne. But yes, if they put me where people look lost, I can get them pointed without everybody barking orders.
You also made those booth labels readable last time, which saved us from three separate salsa-table disasters
Readable labels are cheaper than chaos. Also nobody yells at the table crew on my watch.
Mateo says Eli from the coffee cart is asking if you are free after brunch rush Saturday.
Maybe one hour for coffee, but I am not giving up my whole night. I already promised Marisol I would help reset the kitchen shelves.
One hour, wow. Scheduling you is like booking a manager meeting.
My week is diner, errands, rent math, sleep. Coffee can survive a short slot.
Fridge check before I stop anywhere: your green-lid boxes are taking the whole middle shelf.
Sorry, those are mine for the next two doubles. Rice, egg, little sauce, whatever greens I had left.
Good. Then I am only getting dish soap and tortillas, no random takeout rescue mission.
Deal. If the bowl situation holds, Friday tips stay in the drawer.
If you ever get your little coffee counter thing, please do not schedule open scene night after a brunch shift. I will collapse.
Noted. Thursday nights only, and the wall swap happens on Sundays when people can bring pieces without rushing.
You already have wall swap rules?
Basic ones. No huge fee, one corner saved for someone who has never had a label card before.
Did the supervisor packet finally stop yelling at you?
Mostly. I had to redo the section with the little bubbles because I left the follow-up blank and it made me confirm it twice.
Classic government form energy. Did they also ask every address since forever?
Your mom knew exactly which register drawer was sticking at the diner. I forget she did counters before.
Yes, and mine was boring: Modesto lines all the way down. I used 09/14/1999 from the county copy so HR cannot typo it.
She can spot a bad receipt roll from ten feet away. Dad was the one who knew every loading bay behind McHenry.
That explains why you give directions by stores, alleys, and which road floods first.
Blame growing up here and getting sent on errands before I could drive.
Gallery fundraiser is next Friday. Same night as that voter guide thing at the library.
Can we do library first, then swing by gallery? I want the plain sheet on school cuts and the arts grant before everyone starts yelling online.
Works. I also want to hear the questions about the family-planning van and translation help at the shelter.
Same. The candidates I usually like are mostly there, but I still want answers in person.
You still got that map board above your desk with the red string to Spain and Mexico?
It is not red string, dork. It is two bus-ticket stubs and pictures I printed after a slow shift.
So if you get picked for that art thing, am I helping move boxes or just feeding your plants?
Plants. Maybe one suitcase. I am not doing a whole dramatic exit over a few months.
When we go tomorrow remind me what I liked there. I forgot my own order lol
Patty melt, no tomato, fries well done. You stole my ranch last time.
Accurate. Also if my coworker comes he might ask for no pork, no lard. You know how to ask that?
I can ask: sin puerco? sin manteca? Then double-check with the cook.
The yelling started again by the alley. I'm locking the kitchen window.
Good. If it gets like last year, use the city line, not 911. Last time they just made a note and left.
I remember. You were calm but annoyed they didn't give a follow-up number until you asked.
Exactly why I want those call logs public at meetings. People should not have to know the magic words.
Are you doing that 8 pm improv thing after closing or are you finally resting?
Going, but only because it is bring-a-chair and throw-in-what-you-can tonight.
Of course. You were with Marisol Monday and Mateo yesterday too, right?
Yeah. I will nap between tables if Chef does not catch me.
Your spiral is on the couch under the mail. The page with rent columns is sticking out.
Can you tuck in the printout too? It has the city special-event fee and the names from those two reels.
Done. Also the little wall drawing with the two-top tables is folded inside, so it won't get bent.
Thank you. I need all of that in one place before I forget which numbers were real and which were just ideas.
Did that office call you back, mija? You said they only had Tuesday mornings.
They left a message. I’m off Thursday instead, so I have to wait for the next opening.
Don’t let Sunrise make you feel bad for using the hours you earned.
I know. I just only have 6.5 left and I’m saving them in case Grandma needs a ride.
Your cousin put Grandma's birthday pictures on Facebook. I tagged you so you can see them.
I saw. I was already there checking the downtown weekend post you shared.
You coming by for tacos after work or are you staying late with those papers again?
Staying. Rosa is letting me try the closing count and then look at next week's names on the grid.
Are you cooking after work or eating at the diner?
Cooking if I can find that 15-second lemon pasta again. It was between a server joke and a band clip, so good luck to me.
Eat something first. And don't brush off what she said about you being good when things get messy.
I won't. It felt weird hearing it, but I'm trying to act like she meant it.
We survived table 12. You coming for fries or are you guarding that little cash roll again?
Guarding it. I already have ramen stuff at home and half a bag of spinach from Saturday.
Very responsible and very annoying. At least throw an egg in it.
Already planned. If the tomatoes are still good, those go in tomorrow's rice too.
I updated utilities. Can you send me your final March number before I close the rent sheet?
Yeah. Hourly line is smaller than the table money again. February total was $2,450 before deductions; March might beat it if tomorrow's brunch hits.
Then keep tomorrow's receipts separate so we don't double count the card payout.
Already put an envelope by my keys. I traded into that block for a reason.
I left the tape measure on the kitchen table. Also your napkin drawings are under the rent folder so they don't get coffee on them.
Thank you. Those napkins are basically my floor plan until I can afford grown-up paper.
One has stools, a pastry case, a wall grid, and 'Thursday 8 pm chaos' written on it. Very official.
That one is important. The front window gets the new-person wall so people see it from the sidewalk.
Boss asked if you can cover the patio event tonight. I told him you were already at five stamps on the schedule.
I can do 6:30-9 if they’re desperate, but I’m not redoing makeup after being on since 6.
Fair. Just tie it back again and bring the black shirt. They mainly need hands for plates and refills.
Okay, short cover only. That puts me at 37.5 for the week, so I’m leaving right after cleanup.
Brewery after gallery? Kayla says she can do cheap pretzels.
Maybe. I had wine with Marisol Wednesday, so tonight I'm leaning soda unless the peach sour is tiny.
We are sitting inside. I remember you escaping the sidewalk haze last time.
Bless you. I open at 6:30 tomorrow, so my drawer square waits until I'm back home tomorrow night.
Burger run after hoops or are you doing the spreadsheet thing again?
Spreadsheet thing. If nothing else pops up, April should land back around 1650.
So no extra fries tax?
Not tonight. I can handle a 400 surprise if I have to, but then the little account is basically wiped.
Hoops tomorrow or are you doing the post-diner couch statue thing again?
Maybe just burgers. I did ten hours and the new pair helped, but I'm still moving like a grandma.
Burgers then. Also don't buy that jacket you showed me if you're still paying off the shoes.
